title: GET|PUT /api/v1/verify/cloud-judge
description: The tenant's m1_065 cloud-judge consent (06 §6.5; 16 §L1: judge:grounded-rubric@2 on Nebius Token Factory, global processing): the judge this build would dispatch, and whether a live consent row admits it. Absence is the default (enabled=false, the judge's static disclosure fields); PUT enabled=true writes the only row this route can ever write, PUT enabled=false revokes it.
